QuestInfo.name: [5th Day of Memories] Memories of Protection
QuestInfo.0: #p9010010# has something to discuss with you.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate monsters and collect Great Fortitudes.
QuestInfo.2: Training never ends! Never stop training until Maple World is at peace!

0.0: Long time no see, Great Protector! Do you remember that? I see that many folks got a lot stronger, thanks to the Great Protectors. We should honor their work, and what better way to do that than with some proper training?

yes.0: If you really devote yourself to training, you should be able to find Great Fortitudes from the monsters of Maple World. As proof of your devotion, bring me 50 Great Fortitudes. However, you won't find any on monsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you. Good hunting!

no.0: When it comes to training, how you finish is more important than how you begin...

default.0: You really should be sure you have 50 Great Fortitudes before coming here...
